verdict.rationale: Pipecat's own docs say speech services can be swapped across 200+ integrated providers, usually with one line of code, and a community comment confirms supported providers are easy to onboard. However, TTS is never named explicitly, and nothing shows voice-library browsing or per-voice selection. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported TTS providers, documentation of voice selection or a voice library, and hands-on corroboration of swapping TTS providers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want

citations.quote: Swap speech, language, and vision services from any of 200+ integrated providers and services — usually one line of code.
Orchestrate 150+ AI services with ultra-low latency.
check out any provider they support, and it can be easily onboarded in a few lines of code.
